ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Healer
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has dressed more wounds than anyone. People have started calling {PAWN_objective} the Healer.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Surgeon
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has had a knife inside more colonists than anyone, on purpose. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Surgeon.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Defender
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: More raiders have fallen to {PAWN_nameDef} than to anyone else here. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Defender now, mostly with gratitude.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Deadeye
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps putting shots right where the head is. The others have started calling {PAWN_objective} Deadeye.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Hunter
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: No one here has brought down more game than {PAWN_nameDef}. They call {PAWN_objective} the Hunter now.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Scrapper
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has torn apart more mechanoids than anyone else alive here. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Scrapper.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Builder
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Most of the walls around here went up under {PAWN_nameDef}'s hands. People call {PAWN_objective} the Builder.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Delver
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has dug through more rock than anyone. Some say {PAWN_pronoun} can hear the mountain. They call {PAWN_objective} the Delver.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Greenhand
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has brought in more harvests than anyone, and there's always dirt under {PAWN_possessive} nails. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Greenhand.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Cook
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Most of what the colony eats comes out of {PAWN_nameDef}'s pots. Everyone calls {PAWN_objective} the Cook.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Beastfriend
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Animals follow {PAWN_nameDef} around like old friends. The colony has started calling {PAWN_objective} Beastfriend.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Silver-Tongue
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} can talk a prisoner into almost anything, even joining up. They call {PAWN_objective} Silver-Tongue.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Jailer
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has dragged more prisoners into the cells than anyone. They call {PAWN_objective} the Jailer.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Scholar
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent more hours at the research bench than anyone. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Scholar.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Maker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Pick up any chair or tool in the colony and odds are {PAWN_nameDef} made it. People call {PAWN_objective} the Maker.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Butcher
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has slaughtered more animals than anyone. The children started calling {PAWN_objective} the Butcher, and now the adults do too.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Gravedigger
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has buried more bodies than anyone. Somebody had to. They call {PAWN_objective} the Gravedigger.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Broom
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has cleaned more messes than the rest of the colony put together. Affectionately, mostly, they call {PAWN_objective} the Broom.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Mule
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has carried more things across this colony than anyone. They call {PAWN_objective} the Mule. {PAWN_nameDef} has decided to take it as a compliment.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Smokewalker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Whenever something catches fire, {PAWN_nameDef} is the first one there beating it out. They call {PAWN_objective} Smokewalker.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Kindling
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has caught fire more often than anyone should. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Kindling now, and keeps a bucket of water handy.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Unbreakable
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken more punishment than anyone and is still standing. They call {PAWN_objective} the Unbreakable.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Storm
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has snapped more often than anyone. Behind {PAWN_possessive} back, the colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Storm.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Scavenger
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has stripped more corpses than anyone. They call {PAWN_objective} the Scavenger, and check their boots.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Trigger-Happy
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has fired more shots than anyone, and missed with most of them. They call {PAWN_objective} Trigger-Happy.
